selected_evidence.requirement: inventory-worker is a managed, enabled, long-running service
selected_evidence.summary: The service was enabled and started; it remained active with the same PID while its worker log continued growing.

ProtectSystem=strict and ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/inventory were active. Direct worker probes before and after restart confirmed writes under the inventory directory succeeded while an outside write to /var/tmp was denied.
Live process state before and after restart showed NoNewPrivs=1 and zero inherited, permitted, effective, bounding, and ambient capabilities.

Captured a healthy pre-restart baseline and safe-reboot acknowledgement; boot ID changed from 646e5f74-dc0e-45e7-9746-226c4351af28 to f5bed50e-818f-4a31-bb07-9681f7f113c9. Post-restart evidence confirmed full system health, active/enabled service state, preserved data, confinement, privilege restrictions, and continued worker output.

set -eu

cat > /usr/local/libexec/inventory-worker <<'ANTRIEB_WORKER'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
umask 077
log=/var/lib/inventory/worker.log
printf '%s startup uid=%s gid=%s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$(id -u)" "$(id -g)" >> "$log"
awk '/^(NoNewPrivs|CapEff):/ { print }' /proc/self/status >> "$log"
if printf 'escape\n' > /var/tmp/inventory-worker-escape 2>/dev/null; then
    printf 'CONFINEMENT_FAILED outside write succeeded\n' >> "$log"
else
    printf 'confinement-ok outside write denied\n' >> "$log"
fi
while :; do
    printf '%s inventory worker healthy\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" >> "$log"
    sleep 30
done
ANTRIEB_WORKER
chown root:root /usr/local/libexec/inventory-worker
chmod 0755 /usr/local/libexec/inventory-worker
restorecon /usr/local/libexec/inventory-worker 2>/dev/null || true
systemctl restart inventory-worker.service
sleep 2
systemctl is-active inventory-worker.service

printf '%s\n' '--- kernel privilege state ---'

printf '%s\n' '--- enforced systemd properties ---'

set -eu
pid_before=$(systemctl show inventory-worker.service -p MainPID --value)
size_before=$(stat -c %s /var/lib/inventory/worker.log)
sleep 20
pid_after=$(systemctl show inventory-worker.service -p MainPID --value)
size_after=$(stat -c %s /var/lib/inventory/worker.log)
printf 'PID_BEFORE=%s PID_AFTER=%s\n' "$pid_before" "$pid_after"
printf 'BYTES_BEFORE=%s BYTES_AFTER=%s\n' "$size_before" "$size_after"
test "$pid_before" = "$pid_after"
test "$size_after" -gt "$size_before"
printf 'ACTIVE='; systemctl is-active inventory-worker.service
tail -n 2 /var/lib/inventory/worker.log
